props.name: controller
props.description: The controller managing this component's state and behaviour. Bind to it to access the component's imperative API.

props.name: onfirstcreate
props.description: A callback that fires when the component's controller is first created.

props.name: config
props.description: The configuration object for the responsive board.

props.name: lg
props.description: Snippet for large breakpoint (no params - breakpoint is implicit).

props.name: md
props.description: Snippet for medium breakpoint (no params - breakpoint is implicit).

props.name: sm
props.description: Snippet for small breakpoint (no params - breakpoint is implicit).

props.name: xs
props.description: Snippet for extra-small breakpoint (no params - breakpoint is implicit).

props.name: children
props.description: Children snippet used as fallback when no specific breakpoint snippet matches. Receives `{ currentBreakpoint: string }` as a parameter.

properties.name: definedBreakpoints
properties.description: All breakpoint keys that have stored layouts.

methods.name: getLayoutForBreakpoint
methods.description: Gets the layout for a specific breakpoint.

methods.name: setLayoutForBreakpoint
methods.description: Sets the layout for a specific breakpoint.

methods.name: hasLayoutForBreakpoint
methods.description: Checks if a layout exists for a specific breakpoint.

ResponsiveFlexiBoardConfiguration.name: breakpoints
ResponsiveFlexiBoardConfiguration.description: Breakpoint definitions mapping breakpoint keys to minimum viewport widths (in pixels). Breakpoints are evaluated in descending order - the largest matching breakpoint wins. Use 'default' as the fallback when no breakpoint matches.

ResponsiveFlexiBoardConfiguration.name: onBreakpointChange
ResponsiveFlexiBoardConfiguration.description: Callback fired when the active breakpoint changes.

ResponsiveFlexiBoardConfiguration.name: onLayoutsChange
ResponsiveFlexiBoardConfiguration.description: Callback fired when any layout changes (widget moved, resized, added, or removed). Receives all breakpoint layouts, including the updated current one.

ResponsiveFlexiBoardConfiguration.name: loadLayouts
ResponsiveFlexiBoardConfiguration.description: Function to load initial layouts on mount. Called once when the responsive board is ready.
